description: This file contains functions and logic for managing ACP (Auto-Reply Control Plane) sessions, including spawning, binding, steering, and closing sessions, with integration to various policies, session management, and channel plugins.

methods.name: resolveAcpBindingLabelNoun
methods.description: Determines the label noun ('thread' or 'conversation') based on parameters such as conversation ID, thread ID, and placement.

methods.name: resolveBoundReplyChannelData
methods.description: Builds reply channel data for a given binding and placement, using channel plugin if available.

methods.name: bindSpawnedAcpSessionToCurrentConversation
methods.description: Binds a spawned ACP session to the current conversation, considering policies and existing bindings.

methods.name: bindSpawnedAcpSessionToThread
methods.description: Binds a spawned ACP session to a thread, with policy checks and existing binding validation.

methods.name: cleanupFailedSpawn
methods.description: Cleans up a failed spawn, including deleting session and transcript if needed.

methods.name: persistSpawnedSessionLabel
methods.description: Stores label and update timestamp for a spawned session in session store and persistent storage.

methods.name: handleAcpSpawnAction
methods.description: Main handler for spawning an ACP session, including initialization, binding, and response composition.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionForCommandOrStop
methods.description: Resolves an existing session or stops execution if resolution fails.

methods.name: resolveAcpTokenTargetSessionKeyOrStop
methods.description: Resolves a session key from command tokens or stops if unable.

methods.name: withResolvedAcpSessionTarget
methods.description: Resolves session target and executes a callback with the session context.

methods.name: runAcpSteer
methods.description: Executes a steering turn on an ACP session and collects output events.

methods.name: handleAcpSteerAction
methods.description: Handles steering commands for an ACP session, including parsing, validation, and execution.

methods.name: handleAcpCloseAction
methods.description: Closes an ACP session and unbinds associated bindings.
